findings.title: Reject malformed report items as load errors
findings.description: `cast` does not validate JSON data at runtime. If `items` contains a non-object value (for example, `{"items":[null]}`), `BatchItemRecord.from_json` calls `.get` on that value and raises `AttributeError`. That exception is not converted to `BatchReportLoadError` here or handled by `resume_item`, so a malformed report can produce a traceback instead of the documented clean refusal. Validate the item collection and each item’s shape before deserializing, and test malformed entries.

findings.title: Reject item-resume flags with dry-run mode
findings.description: The `--dry-run` handler runs before the `--resume --item` handler, and the flag checks do not reject their combination. For example, `sq run P6 --resume <run_id> --item 401 --decision retry --dry-run` takes the dry-run path and never attempts the requested item resume. Reject this conflicting combination explicitly so the CLI cannot silently ignore the resume request.
